steps.description: Identify cities known for excellent air quality suitable for a weekend getaway
Select a city from the identified list that fits the weekend timeframe and family-friendly criteria
Retrieve current and forecasted air quality data for the selected city during the weekend
Find accommodation options suitable for a family in the selected city for the weekend
Gather a list of family-friendly activities and attractions in the selected city
Compile travel logistics and recommendations for the weekend getaway
